# Extensions

Each extension is a Go module in [`ext/`](https://github.com/pockethost/pocketone/tree/main/ext) with its own README; the pages here are those READMEs. Want to add one? Read [Writing an extension](/docs/writing-an-extension).

## Standard extensions

These ship with `pocketone` and add no work to an app that doesn't use them.

| Extension | What it does |
|---|---|
| [PITR](/docs/extensions/pitr) | Point-in-time restore of your database with Litestream. On by default. |
| [Auto TLS](/docs/extensions/autotls) | Certificates on demand and wildcards through ACME. |
| [Bulk Mail](/docs/extensions/bulkmail) | Campaigns to your app's own users, with audiences from a collection, a view or SQL. |
| [Pages](/docs/extensions/pages) | Server-rendered pages from a pb_pages folder (formerly PocketPages). |
| [Vacuum](/docs/extensions/vacuum) | Scheduled SQLite VACUUM. |
| [MCP](/docs/extensions/mcp) | An MCP endpoint at /mcp so agents can manage your app and call its tools. |
| [OAuth Server](/docs/extensions/oauth-server) | Your app as an OAuth provider; pocketone login and MCP sign-in use it. |
| [S3 Redirect](/docs/extensions/s3redirect) | File downloads as short-lived signed S3 redirects. |
| [Tokens](/docs/extensions/tokens) | Long-lived API tokens with scopes. |
| [Deploy](/docs/extensions/deploy) | pocketone deploy, dev, pull and logs, and the deploy API. |
| [Remotes](/docs/extensions/remotes) | Named remotes and saved logins for the pocketone command. |
| [Upgrade](/docs/extensions/upgrade) | pocketone upgrade to the latest release, keeping the old executable. |
| [Config](/docs/extensions/config) | The pocketone.yaml config file, with secrets in a .env beside it. |
| [JS Errors](/docs/extensions/jserrors) | JS hook errors that name the pb_hooks file and line. |

## Run many instances

Host hundreds of PocketBase instances in one process, across regions.

| Extension | What it does |
|---|---|
| [Pocker](/docs/extensions/pocker) | Hundreds of PocketBase instances in one Go process, routed by hostname. |
| [Multisite](/docs/extensions/multisite) | Many instances behind one listener, routed by hostname, run by one provider. |
| [Docker](/docs/extensions/docker) | A host provider that runs each instance in its own container. |
| [Sandbox](/docs/extensions/sandbox) | Confines untrusted JS hooks, SQL and outbound network. |
| [Firewall](/docs/extensions/firewall) | Peer allow-lists, trusted proxies and rate limits for a host. |
| [Edge](/docs/extensions/edge) | Forwards each request to the edge that owns the instance. |
| [Mothership](/docs/extensions/mothership) | A control plane and its edges, across regions. |
| [Schedules](/docs/extensions/schedules) | Scheduled webhooks that wake sleeping instances. |
| [Stats](/docs/extensions/stats) | Measures disk use and last request for each instance a host serves. |

## Services for your instances

Shared services a host gives every instance it runs.

| Extension | What it does |
|---|---|
| [Mail Relay](/docs/extensions/mailrelay) | Outgoing mail for instances without SMTP, through your relay, with limits. |
| [S3 Fallback](/docs/extensions/s3-fallback) | A default bucket for uploads and backups when an instance has no S3 of its own. |
| [Server Timing](/docs/extensions/servertiming) | Server-Timing headers for each step of a request. |

## Sell it as a service

Accounts, quotas and billing, for running PocketBase as a service.

| Extension | What it does |
|---|---|
| [Multitenant](/docs/extensions/tenants) | Accounts that own instances: quotas, owner logins, tokens and an API. |
| [Multitenant Billing](/docs/extensions/tenant-billing) | Plans, quotas and the billing provider hook for Multitenant. |
| [Lemon Squeezy Adapter](/docs/extensions/tenant-billing-ls) | Lemon Squeezy as the billing provider. |

## For extension authors

The extension contract and tools for building and testing extensions.

| Extension | What it does |
|---|---|
| [Extension Kit](https://github.com/pockethost/pocketone/blob/main/ext/extkit/extkit.go) | The extension contract: one extension works on a single app and under pocker. |
| [Mail Trap](/docs/extensions/mailtrap) | Dev mode: mail from an app without SMTP lands in a built-in inbox. |
| [Dev Users](https://github.com/pockethost/pocketone/blob/main/ext/devusers/devusers.go) | Local testing only: a superuser and a user with password "password". |
| [JS Embed](/docs/extensions/jsembed) | JS hooks and migrations embedded in the binary. |
